blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – first round MANILA, Philippines–National University outlasted University of Santo Tomas, 87-85, in overtime in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament at Smart Araneta Coliseum on Saturday, courtesy of Reinhard Jumamoy’s game-winner. The Bulldogs were put through the wringer after the Growling Tigers mounted a fierce comeback, but Reinhard Jumamoy came through with a go-ahead triple with 0.5 seconds left. “No comment,” said an exhausted coach Jeff Napa in jest after his NU improved to 4-2. “But really, right from the start of the game, I gave them a question.
